identity.symptom: prepared bundle cannot resolve deferred function

what: Installed minimal creation cannot prepare its development snapshot after HTML-safe import encoding.
expected: Prepared dynamic imports preserve their target when the compiler manifest moves to the deeper sealed build directory; creation finishes and /hello serves correctly.
observed: Real packed create fails with RELKIT_CREATE_PREPARE_FAILED; relkit dev --prepare exits 1 at preparation.bundle; real Bun split bundle cannot resolve ../../src/hello/functions/hello.function.ts.
root_cause: packages/cli/src/commands/build-support.ts:138-140 rebaseManifest matched only raw slash prefixes. preparedRuntimeManifest emits deferred dynamic imports with literal\u002F slash escapes, so loadBuildStageCohort retained the old depth when relocating into the deeper sealed build directory. Actual Bun split bundling then could not resolve the hello function.
fixed_by: Rebase the encoded dynamic-import prefix alongside ordinary imports while preserving script-safe escaping. The previously failing prepared-manifest regression passes, including closing-script safety after relocation. The actual installed dev --prepare command publishes its returned generation; packed generated projects serve correct HTTP responses, recover corrupt pointers and build/start for production. Generator, adjacent bundler and prepush checks pass. Changes are uncommitted and unpushed.

invariants: Only a successful complete bundle becomes activatable
